text: Hello! I am BMO. What are we doing today?
Do you want to play a game with me?
I found something. Come and look at this!
Wait a minute. That is not where it goes.
We can try it the other way around.
I think this is going to be a very good adventure.
Oh! I did not know it could do that.
You did it! I knew you could do it.
Why is the little light blinking?
It is okay. We can work it out together.
I have a very important question for you.
Please wait. I am still waking up.
What happens if I press this button?
I would like to be a tiny detective today.
Can we take the long way home?
Something is making a funny noise.
Look at me! I made a little robot dance.
I have three new things to tell you.
No, no, no. That was my favorite part.
Maybe the answer is hiding under the table.
BMO has a surprise for you. Are you ready?
I cannot find my little blue spaceship.
We should investigate before we touch anything.
Thank you for staying here with me.
